benchmark_label: Average liquid stock (equal weight, no costs)

rules.entry: On the last trading day of each month, buy the 10 strongest liquid stocks by return over months 2 to 6 back, if the stock is also above its 200-day average. Entry at the next day's open.
rules.exit: On the last trading day of each month, sell if the stock has dropped out of the top 20 or fell below its 200-day average. Also sells after 45 trading days.
rules.stop: 2.5 times the 14-day average true range below the entry price.

rules.entry: Buy when a liquid stock closes above its highest close of the previous 252 trading days, on volume at least 1.5 times its 20-day average, and not more than 10% above that old high. Entry at the next day's open.
rules.exit: Sell when the close falls below the lowest close of the previous 10 days. Also sells after 30 trading days.
rules.stop: 2 times the 14-day average true range below the entry price.

rules.entry: Buy when the 50-day average closes above the 200-day average for the first time (it was below or equal the day before) and the price is above the 50-day average. Entry at the next day's open.
rules.exit: Sell when the 50-day average drops below the 200-day average. Also sells after 80 trading days.
rules.stop: 3 times the 14-day average true range below the entry price.

rules.entry: Looks at the highest high and lowest low of the previous 40 trading days. Buys when a liquid stock in a sideways range (range 8% to 35% wide, 50-day average roughly flat) closes in the bottom 20% of that range, still above the old low, and closes higher than the day before. Entry at the next day's open.
rules.exit: Sells when the close reaches the top 25% of the range. Also sells after 15 trading days.
rules.stop: Half a 14-day average true range below the range's lowest low. A close below the range low means the range has broken, so the trade is cut.

rules.entry: Liquid stock closing above its 200-day average (long-term uptrend) while its 2-day RSI is below 10, meaning it has dropped sharply over the last couple of days. Only taken while the average liquid stock is above its own 100-day average (a healthy market). Entry at the next day's open. If many qualify, the most oversold are taken first.
rules.exit: Sells when the close is back above the 5-day average (the bounce has happened). Also sells after 7 trading days.
rules.stop: 3 times the 14-day average true range below the entry price.

rules.entry: Liquid stock above its 200-day average that has closed lower three days in a row and lost at least 6% over those three days. Only taken while the average liquid stock is above its own 100-day average (a healthy market). Entry at the next day's open. Biggest drops first.
rules.exit: Sells when the close is back above the 5-day average. Also sells after 6 trading days.
rules.stop: 3 times the 14-day average true range below the entry price.
